zh.title: FAA因通訊問題下令全美航班全面停飛
zh.summary: 全美航班於01:15 UTC恢復；先前因通訊問題全面停飛
body: 最初的命令於20:10 UTC以「設備中斷」為由，暫停從芝加哥 O’Hare（ORD） 與 Midway 機場出發的所有航班。運輸部長 Sean Duffy 表示，通訊問題影響全美所有航路交通管制中心。FAA表示，決定是「出於格外謹慎」，並與「暫時性電信中斷」有關。
週五晚間記者會上，Duffy表示，20:36時雷達、通訊、管制中心及 TRACONs 在全美各地出現不穩定。FAA技術人員正在調查這項問題。

en.title: FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop for US flights over a communications issue
en.summary: US flights resumed at 01:15 UTC after a nationwide ground stop over a communications issue.
body: The initial order suspended all flights from Chicago’s O’Hare (ORD) and Midway Airports at 20:10 UTC over an “equipment outage.” Transport Secretary Sean Duffy said the communications issue affected all Air Route Traffic Control Centers. The FAA said the decision was taken “out of an abundance of caution” over a “temporary telecommunications outage.”
At a Friday evening press conference, Duffy said radar, communications, centers and TRACONs across the country experienced instability at 20:36. FAA technicians were investigating the issue.
